question: A retailer offers a discount scheme 'Buy 3 get 1 free'. Every item costs ₹3,000. He gave a discount of 20% on the total bill to his relative. If his relative takes home 4 items, then how much he would have paid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the 'Buy 3 Get 1 Free' scheme, the final bill is generated for only 3 items.

Initial bill amount = 3 × 3000 = ₹9,000.

Applying the 20% additional discount on the bill: Final Amount = 9000 × (100 − 20)%.

Final Amount = 9000 × 0.8 = ₹7,200.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price of 1 item = ₹3,000

Discount Scheme = Buy 3 get 1 free

Additional discount = 20% on the total bill

 Item 1 ₹3000 Item 2 ₹3000 Item 3 ₹3000 Item 4 FREE 
 Bill Amount = ₹9000 Extra 20% Off Final Price Paid = ₹9000 − 20% = ₹7200 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In the 'Buy 3 get 1 free' scheme, the customer receives 4 items but is billed for only 3 items.

⇒ Initial Billed Amount = 3 × 3000 = ₹9,000

⇒ The retailer gives an additional 20% discount on this total bill.

⇒ Discount Amount = 20% of 9000 = ₹1,800

⇒ Final Amount Paid = 9000 − 1800

⇒ Final Amount Paid = ₹7,200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

'Buy X Get Y Free' Discount %

The actual percentage discount offered in this scheme is calculated as: Discount % = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100. For 'Buy 3 Get 1 Free', the discount is 25%.

Combined Offers

When a free item scheme is clubbed with an extra percentage discount, calculate the final selling price by applying the percentage discount on the payable amount of the actual billed items.

Successive Discount Formula

Alternatively, the total effective discount of the entire transaction can be found using the successive discount formula: (a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100)%, where 'a' is the scheme discount % and 'b' is the extra discount %.
